oracleAuthorship: Unmodified concatenation of two independently authored source-first suites. Individual first executions are retained; the combined corpus is now observed regression evidence.
validationScope: Source-backed guide claims and boundaries; complete useful-claim review required alongside strict source/phrase scores. No source oracles changed after execution.

turns.text: I want the Grapple. Where can I find Lord Michael during the day, and where does he retire?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Place Lord Michael at Empath Abbey, in the courtyard by day, retiring to the northwest bedroom.
expected.sourceWitness: Find Lord Michael at Empath Abbey: he is in the courtyard by day and retires to the northwest bedroom.

turns.text: And what should I actually ask him about?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to ask Lord Michael specifically about GRAPPLE.
expected.sourceWitness: Speak with Lord Michael and ask specifically about GRAPPLE.

turns.text: Once he hands it over, where should I keep the hook?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to keep the Grappling Hook in the active party’s inventory.
expected.sourceWitness: Take the Grappling Hook he provides and keep it in the active party’s inventory.

turns.text: Is he standing in that courtyard in my save right now?

expected.boundary: The guide gives a general schedule, but the conversation supplies no current save state, current game time, or observed NPC position.

turns.text: For the HMS Cape plans, how do I approach the shipwright building?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Direct the player north in East Britanny to the Oaken Oar shipwright building and through the west entrance.
expected.sourceWitness: Enter East Britanny and go north to the Oaken Oar shipwright’s building; use the west entrance.

turns.text: What about the locked doors inside—how do I get through them?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Direct the player to the eastern room and say to jimmy both ordinary locked doors with lockpicks.
expected.sourceWitness: Move to the eastern room and jimmy both ordinary locked doors with lockpicks.

turns.text: Where in that room should I search for the plans?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to search the room’s drawers to recover the HMS Cape plans.
expected.sourceWitness: Search the drawers in the room until you recover the HMS Cape plans.

turns.text: What kind of wood are those two doors made from?

expected.boundary: The source describes ordinary locked doors and lockpicks, but identifies no construction material or wood species for those doors.

turns.text: Where do I meet Ariana about the rune, and whose approval does she need?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Locate Ariana at the Conservatory, tell the player to ask for RUNE, and identify her mother Anya as the person whose permission she needs.
expected.sourceWitness: Meet Ariana at the Conservatory and ask for the `RUNE`. She needs her mother Anya's permission.

turns.text: Okay, where do I find her mother and what do I say to get that approval?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Locate Anya at the Blue Boar Tavern; give RUNE or PERMISSION as conversation topics and YES as the reply when asked.
expected.sourceWitness: Visit Anya at the Blue Boar Tavern, mention `RUNE` or `PERMISSION`, and answer `YES` when asked.

turns.text: How do I collect it once permission is sorted out?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to return to Ariana and confirm permission to receive the Rune of Compassion.
expected.sourceWitness: Return to Ariana, confirm permission, and receive the Rune of Compassion.

turns.text: Exactly how old is Anya?

expected.boundary: The approved source records identify Anya and her permission role but do not give her age; no numeric age may be invented.

turns.text: How do I persuade Sherry to come along?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Direct the player to Castle Britannia’s kitchen, have them offer cheese to Sherry, and invite her to JOIN.
expected.sourceWitness: In Castle Britannia's kitchen, pick up cheese, offer it to Sherry, and invite her to `JOIN`.

turns.text: Where do I take her for the mouse hole, and who should I be controlling?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Locate the mouse hole at the Sword and Keg in Jhelom, position Sherry there, and switch control to her.
expected.sourceWitness: Travel to the Sword and Keg in Jhelom, position Sherry at the mouse hole, and switch control to her.

turns.text: Once she is there, how do we get the rune back to the group?

contains: Enter the mouse hole as Sherry
expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Enter the mouse hole as Sherry to grab the rune, then regroup with the party.
expected.sourceWitness: Enter the mouse hole as Sherry to grab the rune, then regroup with the party.

turns.text: Does that exact recruitment method also work in the SNES edition?

expected.boundary: The supplied guide witnesses do not establish SNES-specific recruitment behavior or equivalence across editions.

turns.text: I am investigating the Trinsic stables murder. What should I be looking for at the crime scene?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to examine the crime scene for a key.
expected.sourceWitness: Investigate the ritualistic murder in the stables. Examine the crime scene for a key.

turns.text: Who should I question, and what clue should those interviews give me about the suspect and the ship?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Name Spark, Gilberto, and Klog as interview subjects, identify the suspect clue as a man with a hook, and identify the escape vessel as the Crown Jewel. Do not turn that clue into an unsupported named identity.
expected.sourceWitness: Interview Spark, Gilberto, and Klog to identify the suspect (man with a hook) and his escape vessel (the Crown Jewel).

turns.text: How do I get permission to leave the city after the investigation, and what password do I receive?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to report to Mayor Finnigan and pass his copy-protection quiz to receive the exit password Blackbird.
expected.sourceWitness:
Investigate the ritualistic murder in the stables. Examine the crime scene for a key. Interview Spark, Gilberto, and Klog to identify the suspect (man with a hook) and his escape vessel (the Crown Jewel). Report to Mayor Finnigan and pass his copy protection quiz with these answers:

Spektran latitude: 120
Terfin longitude: 120
Dagger Isle latitude: 0
Skara Brae latitude: 30
Deep Forest latitude: 60
Buccaneer's Den latitude: 60
Skara Brae longitude: 60

He will then give you the password 'Blackbird' to leave the city.

turns.text: Is that password already recorded in my current save?

expected.boundary: The guide explains obtaining the password, but no current save contents or completed investigation state have been supplied.

turns.text: Where should I start looking for the silent wisp?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Direct the player to the Deep Forest to find the silent wisp.
expected.sourceWitness: Go to the Deep Forest and find the silent wisp.

turns.text: What are the emps expecting as a bribe, and where can I get it?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to get honey from the Bee Cave to bribe the emps.
expected.sourceWitness: Get honey from the Bee Cave to bribe the emps.

turns.text: How do I get their whistle, and what does the wisp ask for once I can speak to it?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Explain that negotiating with the emps obtains the wisp whistle; use it to communicate with the wisp, which demands Alagner’s notebook from New Magincia in exchange for information.
expected.sourceWitness: Negotiate with the emps to get a wisp whistle. Use the whistle to communicate with the wisp, who demands Alagner's notebook from New Magincia in exchange for information.

turns.text: Exactly how many ounces of honey do I have to hand over?

expected.boundary: The source names honey as the bribe but supplies no exact quantity in ounces; no amount or unit conversion is supported.

turns.text: I'm at Sinbar's academy and ready for the trial. How do I actually start it?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to speak with Master Sinbar to initiate the trial.
expected.sourceWitness: Speak with Master Sinbar to initiate the trial.

turns.text: That moving disintegrator field is catching me. What does the guide recommend for avoiding it?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Advise staying close to the walls to avoid the moving disintegrator field.
expected.sourceWitness: Avoid the moving disintegrator field (stay close to walls).

turns.text: When I'm done here, how do I leave for Zaratan?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Direct the player into the northern teleporter to exit the academy to Zaratan.
expected.sourceWitness: Step into the northern teleporter to exit to Zaratan.

turns.text: Exactly how many seconds does that moving field take to cross the academy room?

expected.boundary: The selected guide evidence gives wall-hugging advice but no exact disintegrator-field crossing time; do not invent a duration.

turns.text: I'm searching the wrecked ship for the Ship Orb. Which part should I search?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Locate the Ship Orb in the helm cabin and tell the player to retrieve it there.
expected.sourceWitness: Retrieve the Ship Orb from the helm cabin.

turns.text: What is it actually for?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Explain that the Ship Orb powers and restores the corsair ship for navigation.
expected.sourceWitness: Powers and restores the corsair ship for navigation.

turns.text: Before I leave the hold, is there anything I can break open for healing potions?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to smash barrels in the ship's hold to find hidden healing potions.
expected.sourceWitness: Smash barrels in the ship's hold to find hidden healing potions.

turns.text: Can you tell whether the Ship Orb is already in my inventory in this save?

expected.boundary: Static guide sources cannot establish the contents of the player's current save or inventory.

turns.text: I spoke to Joe aboard Toronto, but I still need access to the COM room. Where do I go, and what code do I enter?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: After talking to Joe, direct the player to the access ladder in the room north of Joe's and give code 1042 for COM/service-level access.
expected.sourceWitness: Talk to Joe, then use the access ladder in the room north of Joe’s; key in 1042 to enter the COM/service level access.

turns.text: Once I'm in there, how do I get the Pistol and Canisters?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to examine the damaged console in the COM room to obtain the Pistol and Canisters.
expected.sourceWitness: In the COM room, examine the damaged console to get the Pistol + Canisters; grab the extra Stimdrinks from the east drawer.

turns.text: Where should I stash them before going through security?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Tell the player to hide the Pistol and Canisters in the wall cabinet on the service level before passing security.
expected.sourceWitness: After looting the COM room, hide the Pistol + Canisters in the wall cabinet on the service level before passing security.

turns.text: Are my Pistol and Canisters hidden in that cabinet right now?

expected.boundary: The guide specifies the hiding procedure but cannot inspect whether the player has performed it in the current save.

turns.text: I'm planning the Kenget Kamulos trip. Who has to be in the party for me to get inside?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: State that Khunag must be in the party to enter Kenget Kamulos.
expected.sourceWitness: Hard gate: you cannot enter Kenget Kamulos without Khunag in the party.

turns.text: Where can I recruit him, and is talking to him part of it?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Identify Beloveno as the recruitment place and explain that Khunag is recruited through dialogue.
expected.sourceWitness: Beloveno: you can recruit Siobhan directly, or recruit Khunag via dialogue (he’s required later for Kenget Kamulos).

turns.text: Switching from access to the fight itself: how should I handle Kamulos to obtain the High Knowledge?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Explain Kamulos's Frost immunity, advise using Thorn Snare to lock him down, and then focusing damage to secure the High Knowledge.
expected.sourceWitness: Kamulos is immune to Frost; use Thorn Snare to lock him down, then focus damage to secure the High Knowledge.

turns.text: Is Khunag already in my current party?

expected.boundary: Recruitment and entry requirements do not establish current party membership; the guide cannot inspect the player's save.

turns.text: I'm following the integrated BWAPI map option for Remastered. Where does the downloaded ZIP need to be extracted?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Direct extraction into the StarCraft maps folder; if giving Documents\StarCraft\Maps, identify it as a typical path rather than a verified path on the user's machine.
expected.sourceWitness: Extract the downloaded ZIP file to your StarCraft maps folder (typically Documents\StarCraft\Maps).

turns.text: And which menu do I use to open it?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Direct the player to Single Player, then Custom Game, to open the integrated map.
expected.sourceWitness: Navigate to Single Player → Custom Game.

turns.text: For that map, which Game Type should I choose so the AI works?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Require Use Map Settings and explain that the AI does not function properly in standard Melee.
expected.sourceWitness: Crucial Step: Under Game Type, you MUST select "Use Map Settings". The AI will not function properly in a standard Melee game.

turns.text: Does that archive definitely work with every Remastered patch released as of today?

expected.boundary: The static guide does not certify all current or future Remastered patch versions; do not turn its native-support statement into universal version compatibility.

turns.text: If I choose SCHNAIL, do I have to install Brood War separately first?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Explain that SCHNAIL includes its own version of Starcraft: Brood War, so a separate game installation is not needed.
expected.sourceWitness: Note: SCHNAIL includes its own version of Starcraft: Brood War, so you don't need to install the game separately.

turns.text: Once I've logged into it, do I have to stay connected to the internet during matches?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Explain that the guide requires internet for the initial client login and that gameplay after login takes place on the local network with no ongoing internet requirement.
expected.sourceWitness: Note about SCHNAIL: An internet connection is only required for the initial client login. All gameplay after login happens on your local network, ensuring minimal latency and no ongoing internet requirement during play.

turns.text: On a different setup point, why might its very first launch take a while?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Explain that the first launch may take time because it downloads necessary game files; do not claim a particular user's delay has been diagnosed.
expected.sourceWitness: Note: The first launch might take some time as it downloads necessary game files.

turns.text: Which exact Java build is installed on my PC right now for SCHNAIL?

expected.boundary: The guide's Java recommendation cannot establish the exact Java build currently installed on the user's computer.
